description:
Scope: planning only for lib/zaq/agent/executor.ex missed 343, 406, 474, 598, 620, 627, 636, 638, 658, 743, 749, 753, 769, 773, 798, 805, 808. No production edits, new test hooks, full-suite execution or E2E authoring. Owning public contract: Executor.run/2, with configured-agent selection, stream/error output and telemetry; no operation changes. Action reuse assessment: N/A, adding tests for existing execution operation only. Retain Executor.run -> Factory.ask_with_config -> StreamEvents.consume, ServerManager lifecycle, Outgoing response, Engine.Telemetry; do not add/expose Actions or bypass NodeRouter. Files to edit exclusively: test/zaq/agent/executor_test.exs (small, process-local seam tests, async:true); test/zaq/agent/executor_integration_test.exs (DB-backed telemetry, async:false). Do not edit test/support or production files; existing local stubs may be minimally extended, no global application env/Mox mode.

Tests to add before any implementation (test-only work):
A. executor_test.exs: (343) stub factory stream emits request_failed with status_message_id present but no content delta: error Outgoing, no suppressed flag; if already exercised by integration test 1386, record it as covered there and do not duplicate. (474) run with %{"conversation_id" => UUID} binding, assert exact server scope and %{conversation_id: UUID} history binding using existing StubServerManager mailbox. Also test empty/malformed binding falls back to derived scope, nil history binding, never parse server name. (406) extend a local credential-dependency manager seam that ensures a supervised runtime, then exits only in credential_dependency/1; emit an authentication error and assert safe neutral Outgoing/no leaked owner classification and one dependency lookup. (620) local stop_server_if_current/3 seam raises exit on handled stream failure with real PID, assert Outgoing error survives cleanup and stop was attempted; no sleeps. (627) send a request_failed error {:rejected, :busy} through existing factory events; assert structured failure and no stop_server_if_current message, while a non-busy failure stops only the captured PID; test triple busy separately only if not already exercised. (636,638) local ensure_server/4 returns respectively a malformed {:via, Module, key} where whereis_name raises, and one where it exits, both with a supervised test-local runtime independent of that reference. Assert graceful runtime_unavailable error and no factory ask; verify GenServer.whereis/1 actually takes rescue versus catch on this OTP version; if cannot drive without changing runtime semantics, document non-reachability instead of changing production. (658) on success inject a valid stream with measurements using an atom key guaranteed not to exist as its string equivalent (construct unique key as binary rather than minting atoms); measurement_value's fallback safely skips unknown atom: no crash, no new atom, unchanged outgoing answer. Existing integration 1431 exercises telemetry_dimensions safe_existing_atom (a different call site), so target measurement_value specifically.
B. executor_integration_test.exs: reuse StubFactoryUsage/StubServerManager and Buffer/Point SQL Sandbox setup with explicit allow, flush and own-row cleanup as existing tests do (async:false; avoid shared sandbox). Add a table of event-shaped successes/failures using deterministic :llm_completed + :request_completed/:request_failed, no external network. (769) nonempty model without colon and models with empty provider/model ("openai:", ":x") fall back to configured provider and preserve original model string in qa.llm.call.count dimensions. (773) missing/nil model falls back to configured provider with absent model dimension. Use a real configured-agent fixture with persisted credential if asserting configured-provider resolution; otherwise local StubAgent map yields nil provider, and assert that explicitly. (798) valid event actor plus malformed/absent identity during call attribution (if run rejects actor, this branch cannot be reached on a successful stream; see blocker below); assert no fabricated actor_type/person_id on call telemetry and no implicit privilege. (805) incoming metadata nil/non-map on success with LLM call; assert no conversation_id/session_id dimensions, normal call count. (808) blank-string model or blank metadata conversation/session ID on success; assert dimension key absent (not empty string), while nonempty sibling dimension remains. (743,753) selected agent error and invalid actor plus a three-tuple error+partial map: only if a legitimate existing collaborator returns such a triple; assert recorded call dimensions omit configured provider/actor and error Outgoing retains partial; otherwise mark unreachable. (749) nonmap partial three-tuple: only if supported by actual collaborator contract; otherwise unreachable. (598) partial_execution_data map missing optional keys: only if a legitimate StreamEvents failure can omit them; otherwise unreachable. Keep line-specific proof tied to observed persisted metric keys/values/dimensions, not only boolean error or broad shape.

Fixtures, mocks, isolation: @base_opts, CoverageStubFactory/CoverageStubStatus/StubNodeRouter/start_runtime and execution_event already exist; extend local deterministic factory event variants only for actual stream paths. Prefer existing StubFactoryUsage and StubFactoryStreamErrorWithUsage for real StreamEvents reducer; no mocking Executor, StreamEvents, internal telemetry or network. Existing integration Buffer/Point queries, sandbox ownership and exact metric dimensions are the observability seam. Supervise any runtime; event messages/assert_received or Buffer.flush are barriers, never sleep/poll. If new edge request must be exercised, use already-local OpenAIStub/Req.Test boundary, no external requests. No global config. Property assessment: no new input-space invariant is introduced; fixed boundary examples suffice for these discrete branches. Existing actor-identity property in executor_test.exs remains; if expanding identity/normalization domain, add focused StreamData property for 'absent/malformed identity never yields actor dimensions' only if an authorized success path can supply such an actor. E2E not applicable: no new feature/UI journey.

Reachability audit before writing tests: StreamEvents.result/1 always constructs all optional keys including :answer, :trace, :llm_calls etc, and consume/3 returns {:error, error, result(state)} for failures. Therefore 598 (:error branch of Map.fetch for optional keys) and 749 (nonmap partial branch) cannot be hit from real stream failure. 743 (selected_agent_result non-ok with a partial) and 753 (actor_result non-ok with a partial) are also normally precluded because run/2 short-circuits before StreamEvents on failed selection/identity; do not fabricate an invalid triple solely for coverage. 798 may be precluded by actor validation before call metrics; determine if any legitimate actor shape passes validate but fails identity; if not, document same blocker. 636/638 require abnormal runtime refs from a collaborator; exercise through existing injected manager seam only if such refs are within accepted boundary, otherwise document. 343 can be exercised with nil answer on failed stream; 406/620 use existing rescue/exit defensive contracts via injected boundary. Any unreachable branch: capture code-based evidence in issue notes, flag for parent to decide whether to leave justified uncovered or simplify production separately; do not change production or falsify test data merely to hit line counts.

Validation (implementation owner, not this planning agent): run only targeted files `mix test test/zaq/agent/executor_test.exs test/zaq/agent/executor_integration_test.exs` and, when diagnosing, their targeted file:line tests. Parent owns `mix q` and final targeted `--cover` measurement. No `mix test` full suite, `mix coveralls`, or `mix coveralls.json` in this coverage subtask. Record each line's verified coverage or unreachable rationale, review isolation and no weakened assertions. Documentation update: none for tests-only coverage; if contract changes are proposed, halt and request separate approved scope. This plan creates one task with no dependency edges; no implementation begins here.
title: [coverage] Cover Executor remaining lifecycle and telemetry branches
